subject: Renewal amendment: MSA tweaks + order-bundle redlines
messages:
From: Ava Summers <ava.summers@blueloom.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@blueloom.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueLoom renewal: proposed term change & capacity uplift

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — our execs are ready to move but want two things clarified before legal signs:

1) Term length: BlueLoom would like to shift from 12 months to an 18-month term (start 7/1) to align with our internal budgeting cycle. Can Redwood accept an 18-month term with the same seat-based pricing?

2) Order bundle: we're planning a staged capacity uplift across Q3 with two staggered invoices. Procurement asked if we can reflect a tiered order-bundle in the order form rather than a single lump-sum.

Daniel (copied) will lead legal review; Raj will handle procurement. I attached a marked-up summary (see attachments). Would appreciate a short runbook of what Redwood needs to finalize the MSA updates and order form.

Best,
Ava

Attachments: BL_Renewal_Request_Summary.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Summers <ava.summers@blueloom.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@blueloom.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueLoom renewal: proposed term change & capacity uplift

Thanks, Ava — glad to hear the execs are ready. Quick proposal from our side so legal/procurement can react: 

- Term: Redwood can offer an 18-month term with a pro-rated ramp on renewed committed seats; pricing to remain at the 12-month rate for the first 12 months, then a 5% uplift for months 13-18 (to reflect longer commit).
- Order form: We'll prepare an "order-bundle" that lists the two planned tranches (Q3 baseline + Q4 uplift). Each tranche will have independent billing schedule and quantities.

I've attached a draft MSA with tracked changes highlighting the following redline items we expect to touch: Section 2 (Term & Renewal), Exhibit B (Service Levels), Exhibit D (Data Retention), and the Order Bundle schedule.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal Redwood legal review to confirm Section 2 wording and billing split — Marissa, can you and Laura take point on the MSA redlines?
2) BlueLoom legal to return line-by-line comments on the draft (Daniel).
3) Procurement to confirm PO path and billing addresses (Raj) — if you can confirm by EOD Wednesday, we'll target a finalized bundle next week.

I will schedule a 30-min sync for Wed.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Customer Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BL_Renewal_Draft_MSA_v1.docx (attachment stub), OrderBundle_Draft.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Daniel Kim <dkim@blueloomlegal.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Summers <ava.summers@blueloom.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@blueloom.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueLoom renewal: proposed term change & capacity uplift

Grace — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft. A few line edits from legal (high level below; will return full markups by EOD Thursday):

- Section 2 (Term): Prefer explicit end-date language rather than "18 months from effective date". Would you confirm effective date will be 2028-07-01? If yes, we want an explicit clause that allows a 30-day written notice for early termination for convenience after month 12, tied to an early-termination fee schedule.
- Exhibit D (Data Retention): We need stronger carve-outs for customer audit rights and evidence retention for 3 years.
- Order Bundle: We will accept staggered billing but require a single master PO number tied to all tranches and a consolidated invoice option.

I'll attach annotated pages. Also flagging one commercial ask from procurement: can Redwood hold current pricing for all tranches if we hit the uplift threshold (>=25% increase overall) by the end of Q4? Procurement wants the guarantee in writing.

Thanks,
Daniel Kim
Senior Counsel — Contracts
BlueLoom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <dkim@blueloomlegal.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Summers <ava.summers@blueloom.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@blueloom.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueLoom renewal: proposed term change & capacity uplift

Daniel / Ava — looping in our contracts lead, Laura. A few counterpoints from Redwood legal and proposed language to keep things moving: 

- Effective date: Redwood is comfortable with an explicit effective date of 2028-07-01. We'll reflect the explicit date in Section 2.
- Early termination: we can include a limited convenience termination after month 12 with a pro-rated early-termination fee equal to remaining committed value less a 20% mitigation credit — propose redline in Section 9.
- Data retention / audit rights: we'll add a narrow audit window and keep evidence retention at 18 months; for 3-year retention we'll accept a customer-paid extended retention option (Exhibit D, new subsection).
- Pricing hold: we can commit to holding current unit pricing across tranches if BlueLoom confirms the uplift threshold (>=25% across the term) and executes a single master PO within 10 business days of signature. We'll add the conditional language to the Order Bundle schedule.

Marissa: Karthik and I reviewed the draft terms; attaching the redline PDF for BlueLoom. Laura — can you confirm the exact wording for the early-termination fee and the Exhibit D paid-retention option by EOD Thursday?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations (contracts liaison)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Redline_v2.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Summers <ava.summers@blueloom.com>, Daniel Kim <dkim@blueloomlegal.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@blueloom.com>

Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueLoom renewal: proposed term change & capacity uplift

Great progress — thanks everyone. Quick summary and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

- MSA: Redwood will produce a final tracked MSA incorporating: explicit effective date (2028-07-01), early-termination convenience clause with the pro-rated fee + 20% mitigation credit (Section 9), and Exhibit D updated to include a paid 3-year evidence retention option. (Owner: Laura B.; deliverable: tracked MSA v3 by Fri 5/24 EOD)
- Order Bundle: Redwood will publish an order-bundle template with two tranches and conditional pricing-hold language tied to the 25% uplift threshold and single master PO (Owner: Karthik I.; deliverable: OrderBundle_Diff.pdf and clean OrderBundle by Fri 5/24)
- Procurement: BlueLoom to confirm PO path and whether consolidated invoice is mandatory (Owner: Raj; ask: confirm by Wed 5/29)
- Legal signoff: BlueLoom legal to return annotated MSA pages or accept Redwood redline by Thu 5/24; if there are material open items after that call, schedule exec escalation.

I'll set the Wed 5/22 30-min sync now (calendar invite sent). If anyone needs a separate legal-only call, flag and we'll carve 45 mins.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Customer Expansion
Redwood Inference
